scopedCoverageNotes.text: Complete current county-style candidate coverage: all171 original state sample PDFs/342 pages acquired through216 public polling-place results. Thirty local candidate fields and57 named candidates are included. Every applicable style agrees on full names, printed parties and vote limits; the current stateCSV independently matches every field. Six held county/Raleigh contest IDs and20 held candidacy IDs are preserved;24 genuinely missing candidate fields are added.

County combined booklet cover/key confirms171 double-sided styles. Its302 precinct/style rows for216 precincts exactly match all public state results, including75 split precincts. No registered-voter lookup, name, birth date, registration number or personal address was used. Election/date/county are checked in every PDF.

Superior Court and District Court subdistricts are separate electorates even when district labels coincide. DistrictAttorney10, county commission districts1/2/3/7, school-board districts1/2/7/9 and Raleigh council districtsA–E retain exact nominal district IDs. Source-backed style/precinct facts await boundary/division joins; split precincts are not installed as whole-member links. At-large county and Raleigh offices preserve their established full electorates.

All printed named candidates are retained, including unopposed judicial/commission/council fields and minor-party names where applicable. Blank Write-in lines are excluded as identities. No separate local declared-write-in certification or cancellation list was established; no blanket absence is asserted. Other election dates in the state candidateCSV are not imported into November fields.

Federal, statewide Supreme/Appellate and legislative contests, held measures and explainers remain preserved by omission. County/Raleigh/Knightdale bond questions visible on the full source set are ancillary source coverage; no new measure is installed in this candidate-first packet.

All171 original sample PDFs and the original current state candidateCSV are included with hashes. Filed address/contact columns are excluded from reader excerpts/quotes. The county352-page combined booklet original is210MB and remains in task scratch; honestly labelled derived first10 cover/key pages are included, with original URL/hash/byte count. Helpers remain in scratch and no production publication or git operation was performed.
